name: gemini-compact
description: Replaces the compaction summary with Gemini decisions: old tool calls and results are kept, truncated or dropped, and every message stays verbatim. /gemini-compact sets the model, the threshold, the tier and on/off. Needs function hooks (early access).

apiKey.title: Gemini API key
apiKey.description: Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

tier.title: Gemini tier
tier.description: free: Google may use the conversation to improve its products and human reviewers may read it. paid: a billing-enabled key. /gemini-compact free|paid overrides it.

model.title: Gemini model
model.description: The model that decides. /gemini-compact model <id> overrides it.

compactAtPercent.title: Automatic compaction threshold
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage (1-99) after which a finished turn starts a compaction; 0 turns it off. /gemini-compact at <N> overrides it.

keepRecent.title: Newest messages kept whole
keepRecent.description: Tool calls in the newest messages and in the first message are never sent for a decision.

minReduction.title: Minimum reduction
minReduction.description: Fraction (0-1) of characters the decisions must remove; below it the built-in summary runs.

headChars.title: Characters kept of a truncated output
headChars.description: The head of a tool output Gemini truncates.

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs are cut to their head and tail before sending.
